method: Use LeRobot 0.3.3 decode_video_frames with pyav, tolerance_s=0.0001, pinned episode-0 MP4 and timestamps read from pinned parquet. This isolates video lookup after construction was blocked by earlier loader checks; it does not establish successful dataset iteration.

r94:c1:f1.confirm_if: In-bounds episode timestamps near 1.784e9 seconds fail to return corresponding frames from pinned episode-0 MP4.
r94:c1:f1.refute_if: The pinned episode-0 MP4 decodes frames at those raw absolute timestamps within the default tolerance.

r71:c1:f1.confirm_if: The first, middle, or last in-bounds raw timestamps fail to decode from the pinned episode-0 MP4 within default tolerance because of the nonzero start.
r71:c1:f1.refute_if: The first, middle, and last in-bounds raw timestamps decode from the pinned episode-0 MP4 within default tolerance; the nonzero start alone does not make lookup miss.
